purpose: Select exactly one economically interpretable historical-only three-session mechanism after Campaign096, before reading Campaign097 minute rows, candidate values, comparator values, daily prices, or forward returns.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_market_range_profile_synchronization_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock whose intraday high-low range is allocated across clock minutes in the same pattern as the contemporaneous leave-one-out market may be participating in broad, liquid information arrival rather than isolated idiosyncratic stress, and that synchronized state may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For each accepted stock-day use q_i=log(high_i/low_i) on exactly 240 standard bars and normalize p_i=q_i/sum(q). On the same date, sum every complete normalized profile by clock position, subtract the candidate stock, divide by the leave-one-out peer count to obtain m_i, and return the population Pearson correlation Corr(p,m) across the 240 aligned positions.
selected_candidate.source_grid: Require the immutable raw 241-row stock-day identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude 09:30, and preserve all 240 fixed clock positions.
selected_candidate.profile_support: Require every selected high and low finite and strictly positive with low<=high; exact high=low is a valid zero range; require only a strictly positive finite sum of all 240 log ranges. No positive-range minimum, adjacent-pair minimum, bridge, imputation, epsilon, threshold, or dropped bar is allowed.
selected_candidate.peer_support: The benchmark contains only complete normalized profiles. Remove the candidate stock exactly, require at least 50 leave-one-out peers at every clock position, and require both the stock and leave-one-out market 240-vectors to have strictly positive population sum of squared deviations.
selected_candidate.estimator: Equal-clock-weight float64 population Pearson correlation, with only 1e-12 canonicalization of numerical overshoot at -1 or +1.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar and the same-session accepted peer cross-section; no later session, daily return, Candidate49 observation, or provider request enters the factor.
